title: Trump Administration Makes Second Supreme Court Appeal to Preserve USPS Mail Ballot Delivery Policy
detail: The Trump administration petitioned the Supreme Court a second time to preserve its USPS mail ballot delivery policy after losing in two consecutive lower courts. The legal fight centers on a policy that critics say restricts timely mail ballot delivery ahead of the 2026 midterm elections, with voting rights groups arguing the rule disproportionately suppresses mail-in voting. The administration's repeated appeals signal the White House views the policy as a priority ahead of the November midterms.

media.caption: Trump administration appeals to Supreme Court over USPS mail ballot delivery policy
